+from fastapi import FastAPI, APIRouter
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+import os
+
+def test_app_frontend():
+    app = FastAPI()
+    # This should fail currently as .frontend() is not implemented
+    try:
+        app.frontend("/", directory=".scratch/dist")
+    except AttributeError as e:
+        print(f"Caught expected AttributeError for app.frontend: {e}")
+        return
+
+    client = TestClient(app)
+    response = client.get("/")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.text == "Hello from frontend"
+
+def test_router_frontend():
+    app = FastAPI()
+    router = APIRouter()
+    # This should fail currently as .frontend() is not implemented
+    try:
+        router.frontend("/", directory=".scratch/dist")
+    except AttributeError as e:
+        print(f"Caught expected AttributeError for router.frontend: {e}")
+        return
+
+    app.include_router(router)
+    client = TestClient(app)
+    response = client.get("/")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.text == "Hello from frontend"
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_app_frontend()
+    test_router_frontend()
+    print("Tests completed")
